integrity: Exact analytic range/permutation proof with a sharp attained configuration; supporting symbolic identities and independently reconstructed six-permutation numerical stress checks do not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem evaluates only the stated real two-dimensional affine-regular hexagonal norm. It neither classifies all maximizers nor computes the invariant for all polygonal normed spaces. The originality claim is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact Dehghan–Rooin constant of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
